title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00387561167742 from five rational returns and a two-repair bypass
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ ≥ 0.00387561167742** for the complete P104 multiplier. This finite lower bound exceeds the submitted #7781 rational word’s directed upper of **0.00386981257853** by **0.00000579909889**. Giving #7781 the same improved binary service leaves that comparison intact. The fifth rational bypass adds **0.00000009485313** above the immediately preceding #7786 directed upper of 0.00387551682429. I request review of these conditional gains for frontier eligibility.

The original target is 0.00387981257853. Its remaining gap is **0.00000420090111** in κ and **[4.283801810418420331023466, 4.283801810418420331023467]** signed units across 48 rational calls. The maintained selected result on the verified base is #7000 at 0.00363005817. [Selected record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/certificates/selected-result.json)

## Construction and review

Five rational returns, four paid projections and five closed-block bypasses preserve all 400 main fields and the independently required helper outputs on the submitted #7781 supplier. The fifth bypass replaces the grade-two transfers at slots 100302 and 100307 with grade-one and grade-three deliveries at slots 12 and 81. The full signed saving is 48(2H₂ − H₁ − H₃), at least 0.096832450156517956530135 units at the target. The ordinary replay prices the extra local work. The binary supplier uses eight new productive returns and the rooted owner-411 binary repair. [Construction, evidence and cold replay commands](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/172475c2ca321d3496fda7a2a71478ada5acb948/research/p104-iterated-returns)

For a short independent check, set input address 783. Both new rational senders carry 2. Omitting slot 12 changes output 123 from 0 to −2/3, while omitting slot 81 changes output 19 from 0 to 4. The complete audit checks all 1,648,656 coefficients in each orientation and 50 coefficient mutations. The two retired senders and both new senders reject partial CLEAR. [Immediate comparison](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/172475c2ca321d3496fda7a2a71478ada5acb948/research/p104-iterated-returns/evidence/fifth-bypass.json)

The full rational application charges 283,344 paid and 52,272 productive positions across 48 calls. It independently prices 1,294,866,432 scalar services and 151,903,825,920 ordinary records. The 36-call binary service admits 0.003879927836145. The 21 changed physical chart maps, 840,912 caller events and the outer depth guards are included. The five inherited assumptions cover all-column native validity, owned erasure, compiler correctness, precision-tape simulation and analytic recovery. [Full application](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/172475c2ca321d3496fda7a2a71478ada5acb948/research/p104-iterated-returns/evidence/application.json) · [Independent operator and price](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/172475c2ca321d3496fda7a2a71478ada5acb948/research/p104-iterated-returns/evidence/operator.json)

The source-lock manifest identifies 127 public files needed for reconstruction. The Python 3.12 standard-library replay is divided into eight independently runnable parts. The largest local independent audit used under 350 MiB. [Replay instructions](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/172475c2ca321d3496fda7a2a71478ada5acb948/research/p104-iterated-returns/README.md)

Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
